description: Recent Canvas announcements, either for the course_ids you pass or for all your active courses. Each course id can be the Canvas course ID or the course name. Pass limit to show fewer or more than 20 announcements, and page to see the next ones. Example: "What did my instructors announce in Canvas lately?"

items.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.

limit.description: Optional, how many items to show per list. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Optional, which page of items to show, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

name: get_announcements
title: Announcements
